supporting_observations.claim: WS-EBROOKS-01 made repeated TCP connections to the explicit proxy at 10.54.20.30:8080 during the alert period, including connections at 13:39:24, 13:44:32, 13:49:25, 13:54:18, 13:59:51, and 14:04:45 UTC.

The observed proxy connections recur at roughly five-minute intervals for much of the alerted window, but the supplied connection records do not identify the HTTPS destination or the originating process.

A nearby, separate proxy record shows a successful CONNECT tunnel to login.microsoftonline.com at 13:29:25 UTC, but it does not establish the destination or legitimacy of the later alerted connections.

known_telemetry_limitations: The relevant Zeek records show connections from the workstation to the proxy, not the destination host or domain inside any HTTPS CONNECT request.
The supplied records do not attribute the alerted proxy connections to a process, executable, or user.
The organization inventory says StockPilot checks for updates about every five minutes, but the available records do not link the alerted connections to StockPilot or its updater.
claims_not_established: Whether the alerted connections reached an approved service such as StockPilot or an unapproved destination.
Whether the connections were initiated by legitimate software or by an unauthorized process.
What data, if any, was sent or received through the connections.
Whether the activity was malicious or benign.
additional_evidence_needed: Proxy CONNECT or request logs for the alerted connections, including destination hostnames, timestamps, and response status.
Endpoint network telemetry that maps each connection to its originating process and command line.
StockPilot updater execution, signature, and update-check logs for WS-EBROOKS-01 during the alert window.
If available, TLS SNI or other network metadata that identifies the remote destinations.
unrelated_findings: A UserAssist registry value on WS-EBROOKS-01 contains a ROT13-encoded path to PowerShell. This is not proof of execution during the alert window and is not linked by the supplied records to the alerted connections; review separately. (T185-00001)
